text: the generalizability of values. Hoeger and colleagues (104) found that a load of 80% of 1RM corresponded to 10RM in the bench press, lat pulldown, and knee extension; however, this intensity of load varied from 6RM for the leg curl and 7RM to 8RM for the arm curl, to 15RM for the leg press. Moreover, the accuracy of these formulae declines substantially as loads become progressively lighter. To this end, another study showed that, for individual subjects, repetitions to failure in the leg press ranged between 7 and 24 at 75% of 1RM, whereas the disparity widened to 30 to 71 at 30% of 1RM (207).
